title: def-cache-carriers
description: Which mods/plugins act as a def-cache plugin, detected by the DLL they drop and the Player.log line prefix they write.

id.description: A short, stable identifier for this carrier.

plugin_dir.description: The subfolder of a mod's own loaded folder the DLL is dropped in.

file_prefix.description: The DLL's file-name prefix, matched case-insensitively.

recursive.description: Whether to walk plugin_dir recursively. Defaults to false when omitted.

log_line_prefix.description: The prefix of this carrier's own Player.log lines, matched exactly on the trimmed line.
